name: dsh-entry-transition
description: One-shot entrance animation for the DSH workspace: logo is written onto the canvas, an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.

meta.title: Entry Transition
meta.description: 打开工作台时的一次性入场动画：标识在画布上逐字擦出，退场时反色色块自左缘扫过整屏，内容压暗让位。深浅主题自动镜像，只动合成层，顺滑不掉帧。装上即用，零配置。
